facts.text: Snow left Harkness Flat (6,200 ft) 19 days earlier this year than the midpoint of two of the three earlier seasons on file (2024 and 2025).

evidence.name: Harkness Flat
evidence.detail: left April 24; earlier seasons: May 12 (2024), May 14 (2025); 2023: no readings on file

facts.text: At Harkness Flat (6,200 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 1.9 in, the lowest of three of the four seasons on file (2024 to 2026).

evidence.name: Harkness Flat
evidence.detail: 1.9 in on April 13; earlier seasons: 28.5 in (2024), 33.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 3 and May 16, carried from the melt-out date at Harkness Flat (6,200 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Harkness Flat
evidence.detail: melted out April 24, at the pass elevation; points to April 3 to May 16
